cues.text: Takaya stumbles across the platform alone, hunched over, one hand clutching his chest.
A crushing force slams down from above. You and the others are thrown onto your hands and knees, Koromaru pressed flat against the floor, and Takaya is knocked off his feet.
Takaya collapses onto his back and lies still.
Junpei strains to push himself up off the floor, then the weight drives him back down.
You sink lower under the weight.
